_comment: Values the sync cannot derive from query-docs. Hand-maintained; the sync reads this and never writes it. Keys are function names in UPPERCASE.

_schema.returns: scalar | table - used when the doc has no '## Return value' section to parse, or when the parser misreads the one it has (see _returnsMisread)
_schema.primaryCategory: overrides the first-index-wins rule for functions listed in several category indexes
_schema.uncategorized: functions upstream classifies nowhere - see its own _reason

_returnsMisread._reason: The parser only calls a return value 'table' when the first line names a table or column. These seven have a Return value section that says rows, a context or values instead, and were stamped 'scalar'. Each line below quotes Microsoft's own first line, measured on the card at query-docs@323524c. ALLCROSSFILTERED and REMOVEFILTERS say 'N/A. See remarks.': they are CALCULATE modifiers that return no usable table, so neither value is true of them and they are left as the parser wrote them rather than given one this repo cannot back.
_returnsMisread.ALLSELECTED: The context of the query without any column and row filters.
_returnsMisread.CURRENTGROUP: The rows in the table argument of the GROUPBY function corresponding to one group of values of the groupBy_columnName arguments.
_returnsMisread.FILTERS: The values that are directly applied as filters to columnName.
_returnsMisread.INDEX: A row at an absolute position.
_returnsMisread.OFFSET: One or more rows from relation.

uncategorized._reason: No category index lists these and toc.yml has no entry for them, so upstream classifies them nowhere. No category is invented for them: an empty primaryCategory tells an agent that Microsoft did not classify the function, which is true, where a guessed one would be a claim this repo cannot back. Listing them by name is the decision on record - the sync fails on any OTHER function that ends up uncategorized, and fails again if one of these later gains a category and the name is left behind. Five of the original 21 were resolved by reading toc.yml; these 16 have no source at all. Measured against MicrosoftDocs/query-docs@c6a9a72.
